description: PreCompact hard-stops manual and automatic compaction so PM state can be handed off first.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"auto compaction blocked; follow the recovery guide","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Auto compaction was blocked. This thread is over the limit, so another model turn may be blocked again.\nRecovery: 1) /status and copy the chat ID; 2) /quit; 3) run codex resume --disable hooks <CHAT_ID>; 4) run /pm-handoff; 5) start a fresh normal session so hooks are enabled again. This one-shot recovery allows compaction, so the handoff may use a lossy summary.","suppressOutput":false}'
hooks.commandWindows: Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"auto compaction blocked; follow the recovery guide","systemMessage":"[ctx-tripwire] Auto compaction was blocked.
